caption: The video showcases an overhead orbital view of a Space Shuttle, the name Atlantis legible on its wing root, floating against Earth's swirling cloud cover. Its payload bay doors stand open, revealing tan and orange cargo canisters arranged inside. Mounted alongside the shuttle is a large open-ended cylindrical payload whose aperture faces the camera, with a small dark sphere tethered to it by a thin line. The assembly keeps a fixed internal configuration, drifting subtly within the frame as the cloud field shifts behind it. The tethered sphere holds a roughly constant distance from the open cylinder, moving with the assembly rather than independently. Partway through the clip, a separate silver cylindrical object with a white end cap enters at the right edge. It translates leftward into view, closing the gap toward the shuttle yet remaining fully separated.
